steps.title: Configure Shared Scanner Architecture
steps.description: Created a unified scanning pipeline for both Camera scanner and Gallery image decoder.

steps.title: Fix Tesseract Dependency Jar Manifest Collision
steps.description: Identified duplicate AndroidManifest.xml inside bundled local library JARs causing package failure.

steps.title: Exclude Duplicate AndroidManifest.xml from Gradle Packaging
steps.description: Added explicit packaging resource exclusions in app/build.gradle to prevent APK entry collisions.

steps.title: Implement Image Preprocessing and Enhancement Pipeline
steps.description: Added grayscale conversion, contrast boosting, and text region preprocessing for higher OCR precision.

steps.title: Implement Robust Luhn 15-Digit IMEI Extraction
steps.description: Added label detection for IMEI 1 & IMEI 2 with Luhn checksum validation to prevent false IMEI detections.

steps.title: Add Dynamic Model, Brand, RAM, Storage, and Color Text Parser
steps.description: Implemented text pattern regex matchers for box packaging attributes.

steps.title: Unify Live Camera Frame Processing for QR, Barcode, and OCR
steps.description: Enabled simultaneous live camera detection of QR codes, barcodes, and printed text frames.

steps.title: Upgrade Gallery Image Picker to Unified Multi-Angle Pipeline
steps.description: Integrated multi-angle QR/Barcode/OCR decodes for selected packaging photos.

steps.title: Integrate Extracted Scanner Results into Product Entry Form
steps.description: Connected combined barcode, QR, and OCR extraction output directly into the auto-filled Product Entry layout.

steps.title: Ensure SQLite Database Persistence and Conflict Safeguards
steps.description: Validated product saving, edit, delete, stock movement, and non-overwriting empty field rules.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Compatibility and Offline Build Environment
steps.description: Enforced standard inner classes, anonymous listeners, and Temurin 17 Java 8 build compliance.

steps.title: Building Box Stock Manager
steps.description: Compile release APK with dev.ffmpegkit.tesseract OCR box scanner and resolved Gradle packaging rules.
